notes.subject: גר / גרים
notes.rationale: Wanpela tok 'ger' i kamap tupela taim — lo bilong laikim man i kamap long narapela ples i stanap long olsem yu ol yet i bin ol 'ger' long Mitsrayim; Tok Pisin i holim wankain tok.

notes.subject: mas
notes.rationale: Hibru i no gat 'mas' — imperativ ⟨mas⟩ i bracketim long Tok Pisin bilong tok gutpela pasin komand.

notes.subject: Yisrael
notes.rationale: Mose i toktok stret long ol man Yisrael, komand bilong laikim ol man i kamap long narapela ples.

translation: Olgeta yu ol i mas laikim ⟨את⟩ man i kamap long narapela ples, long wanem yu ol i bin ol man i kamap long narapela ples long graun bilong Mitsrayim.
